settings.err_intro: Recent driver steps and errors (pairing, init, cluster binds). Newest first. Survives an app restart.
settings.verbose_hint: Adds init steps, reporting setup and commands sent. Too noisy for everyday use, but turn it on when bringing up a new device. Takes effect immediately.
settings.zdump_intro: Endpoints and clusters of every device paired to this app. Load it, then copy the JSON to share a device's Zigbee interview.
settings.log_intro: Raw values, to analyse a mid-clean recharge. Run a full clean, then export and share the CSV.
settings.imou_intro: Credentials for the Imou Open Platform — the cloud API behind privacy mode and motion detection on the Imou cameras. Create an app at open.imoulife.com/consoleNew/myApp/appInfo and paste its ID and secret here, once, before pairing a camera. The secret is a password: it is stored in Homey's settings, never in this app's code or logs.
settings.imou_host_hint: Leave blank to auto-detect on first use. Filled in automatically once a connection succeeds.
settings.imou_test_ok: Connected — {{count}} camera(s) visible on this account.
settings.somfy_intro: Credentials for the Somfy Protect alarm — an UNOFFICIAL, reverse-engineered cloud API (there is no public developer portal). Use a SECONDARY Somfy Protect account created for this purpose (the app, Settings > add a user), never your own login: create it, invite it, accept once, then enter its email and password here. Give that account the Guest role: it can still arm, disarm and switch night mode (which this app uses, from the device tile or a flow), but it cannot remove devices, change your installation, or manage users.
settings.somfy_test_ok: Connected — {{count}} site(s) visible on this account.
settings.petlibro_intro: Address and login of petlibro-bridge, the container that replaces the Petlibro cloud for the feeders (bridge/petlibro in the repo; setup in the README). The login is one from the bridge's auth/htpasswd file. Set this once, then pair: the pairing screen lists every feeder that has connected to the bridge.
settings.petlibro_test_ok: Connected — {{count}} feeder(s) known to the bridge
settings.petlibro_tools: The bridge's own log, and its raw MQTT capture (every message to and from the feeders) — to decode what the feeder does that this app does not understand yet.

pair.no_reply: No reply from the robot. Check the IP, and wake it in the Xiaomi app.

imou.not_configured: Set the Imou app ID and secret in the app settings (Imou tab) first.

devialet.source_unavailable: That source is not currently available (speaker off, or the group was reconfigured).

somfy.not_configured: Set the Somfy account email and password in the app settings (Somfy tab) first.

kwh_meter.no_source: No source device is linked to this meter — remove and re-pair it.
kwh_meter.source_gone: The tracked device is unavailable or was deleted. The kWh total is kept, but stops updating.

petlibro.not_configured: Set the Petlibro bridge address, username and password in the app settings (Petlibro tab) first.
petlibro.bad_login: The bridge refused the username or password (Settings > Petlibro).
petlibro.no_feeder: The bridge knows no feeder yet. Check that the feeder's internet is blocked and mqtt.us.petlibro.com points to the bridge, then restart the feeder.
petlibro.bad_time: Meal __slot__: "__value__" is not a time — use HH:MM, e.g. 07:30.
petlibro.bad_refill_time: Refill reminder: "__value__" is not a time — use HH:MM, e.g. 09:00.

petkit.bad_time: "__value__" is not a time — use HH:MM, e.g. 22:00.
petkit.bad_range: Each pet's "from" weight must be lower than its "to" weight.

alert.tray_full: Litter box: the waste bin is full — empty it, then press "Bin emptied".
alert.motor_error: Litter box: motor fault (__reason__) — automatic cleaning is stopped until it is cleared.
alert.link_lost: Litter box: the main board stopped answering the motor controller — check the box.
alert.link_lost_cleared: Litter box: motor controller answering again.
alert.offline: Litter box: unreachable for 5 minutes (Wi-Fi or power).
alert.unknown_pet: Litter box: a visit by an unrecognised pet (__weight__ kg) — check the weight ranges.

pair.address_hint: Give the litter box a fixed IP in your router first.
pair.login_hint: The web_username / web_password of the firmware's secrets.yaml.
pair.no_address: Enter the litter box's IP address.
pair.not_our_firmware: This device answers, but does not run the Zigbidouille firmware (KrustyLeBot/esphome-petkit-t4).
pair.unreachable: Could not reach the litter box: __error__
